contentUsePolicy: Benchmark uses aggregate counts only. Chain-v2 component names, prose, design content, prices and part numbers are not imported into the scratch generator.

rows.label: Functional modules
rows.action: Add missing functional modules only when the product class genuinely requires them.

rows.label: Submodules
rows.notes: Submodule count is a rough proxy for engineering decomposition depth.
rows.action: Expand thin modules with concrete sub-functions and carrier interfaces.

rows.label: Component candidates
rows.notes: Component-word count is a rough proxy for BoM review surface, not sourcing quality.
rows.action: Add justified component candidates where submodules still hide assemblies.

rows.label: Interface link volume
rows.notes: Compares link volume only; chain-v2 grammar links and scratch interface edges are not semantically identical.
rows.action: Add interface contracts only where they clarify a real energy, material, signal, load or service path.

rows.label: Admitted priced-line ratio
rows.notes: Prototype target expects most critical lines to become source-backed before publication.
rows.action: Use sourcing intake to admit source-backed price/manufacturer/MPN evidence; do not copy benchmark estimates.

rows.label: Sections scoring >=8
rows.notes: Readiness gate requires every scored section to reach the target.
rows.action: Clear section-specific readiness actions, especially BoM evidence.

rows.label: Verification activities
rows.notes: Scratch-only evidence workflow depth; not compared to chain-v2 content.
rows.action: Keep adding verification activities when new requirements, interfaces or standards are introduced.
